event_summary: A nighttime illuminated fountain display shows changing colored vertical jets, arcing water streams, and broad sprays while the camera reframes upward along nearby buildings.
raw_event_description: The video begins with a wide view of a fountain pool at night, with many warm small lights in the foreground and blue/cyan illuminated water jets across the pool. Several narrow vertical jets are active, a curved water stream crosses from the right side toward the center, and a bright tall plume is visible near the right side. As the sequence continues, the row of vertical jets becomes more evenly visible, the colors shift from blue/cyan toward purple, pink, and magenta, and broad spray sheets form above the jets. Later, the camera tilts and pans upward/right so the glass building facade and upper stories occupy more of the frame while the fountain jets remain active near the bottom and right edges.

reasons: The fountain activity is already underway in the first frame.
The main water jets, pool, foreground lights, and building are visible.
Bright illumination and spray obscure some exact jet origins and pool details.
